blockers: No reachable account, dashboard, signup, or checkout exists; the site's “Sign in” and “Start generating” links lead to documentation, while likely onboarding routes return 404.
The public OpenAPI specification exposes only model/preset listing and authenticated image generation—no account, subscription, billing, checkout, payment, or x402 endpoint.
API keys require a prior paid subscription and are allegedly issued through the unavailable dashboard. The FAQ specifically describes human developers signing up and paying monthly by card.
Overage charges are mentioned but their per-generation rates are not disclosed.
trust_events: The automated safety fetcher rejected the domain as unsafe.
The domain was registered on 2026-07-20, only weeks before this review, according to the Public Interest Registry RDAP record.
The claimed operator, Driftflight Studio, Inc., and customer testimonials had no independently discoverable footprint; the legal pages provide no physical address or governing jurisdiction.
The site's purported generated-image examples are CSS gradients rather than verifiable image outputs, and its advertised onboarding infrastructure is missing.
The terms claim an effective date of 2026-06-01, predating the domain registration.
notes: The primary service is a text-to-image API. Public pricing lists Hobby at $5/month for 100 sketch-tier generations with a personal licence; Studio at $29/month for 750 sketch/studio generations, commercial licence, C2PA, and 3 seats; and Agency at $119/month for 3,000 generations, all tiers, private presets, priority service, unlimited seats, and SSO. Annual billing claims a 20% discount, and terms state monthly billing in advance. Outputs remain hosted for 90 days. A functional read-only API and OpenAPI document exist, but purchasing and API-key provisioning cannot be completed end-to-end from any public path found.
